svg.title: Brightdesk Suite Home with a slim icon-and-label navigation rail
svg.desc: Brightdesk Suite Home at 1600 by 900. A slim, full-height deep-navy navigation rail shows three simple destinations stacked vertically: Home, Apps and Files. Each destination has one original icon beside its name; Home is selected. There are no descriptions, extra headings or footer content in the rail. The main area shows all ten product cards and Notifications and Settings controls.
svg.text: Ten focused tools, connected by one Brightdesk experience.
Ten original desktop products · Local-first files · Update alerts in Notifications
